common.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
common.automated: This is an automated message, so please do not reply to it.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your {appName} address
verifyEmail.preheader: One click and your account is active.
verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.intro: Welcome to {appName}. Confirm that {email} belongs to you and your account is ready to use.
verifyEmail.expiry: The link stays valid for a limited time. If it has expired, request a new one from the sign-in page.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not create this account, you can ignore this message and nothing will happen.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your {appName} password
resetPassword.preheader: A link to choose a new password.
resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.intro: Somebody asked to reset the password for {email}. Choose a new one with the button below.
resetPassword.expiry: The link stays valid for a limited time and can be used once.
resetPassword.ignore: If this was not you, ignore this message. Your password stays as it is.

accountInvited.subject: Your {appName} account is ready
accountInvited.preheader: Set a password and you are in.
accountInvited.title: An account was created for you
accountInvited.intro: An administrator created a {appName} account for {email}. Set your password to finish and sign in.
accountInvited.expiry: The invitation stays valid for 7 days. After that, ask the administrator for a fresh one.
accountInvited.ignore: If you were not expecting this, tell the person who runs this site before using the link.

smtpTest.subject: {appName} test message
smtpTest.title: Outgoing mail works
smtpTest.intro: This message was sent from the administration panel of {appName} to check the mail configuration.
smtpTest.closing: Nothing else was changed. You can delete this message.

passwordChanged.subject: Your {appName} password was changed
passwordChanged.preheader: If this was not you, act now.
passwordChanged.title: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.intro: The password for {email} has just been changed, and every other session on the account was signed out.
passwordChanged.closing: If you made this change, there is nothing to do.
passwordChanged.warning: If you did not, contact the administrator of this site straight away: somebody else has control of the account.

emailChanged.subject: Your {appName} address was changed
emailChanged.preheader: Your account now uses a different address.
emailChanged.title: Your email address was changed
emailChanged.intro: The address on your {appName} account was changed from {oldEmail} to {newEmail}.
emailChanged.closing: This message went to the previous address, which will no longer receive account mail.
emailChanged.warning: If you did not ask for this, contact the administrator of this site straight away.
